ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: The Contagion
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
CONTAGION_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 (Phase A row 16 of design/RimMandrake/biome_mod_architecture.md; parent BIOME_MOD_SPLIT_EXECUTION_1). The Contagion, fully generalized: it names no other franchise or campaign and is playable standalone on any generated RimWorld planet. A separate frozen campaign world's own instance is unaffected; this is a new sibling biome for everyone else's worlds, not a rename of that one.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it.
A red valley on a scalded mountain, roofed by a thunderstorm that has never been known to stop: an open-throttle bioweapon mutation engine, running unchecked because it is the one place on the dayside where heat and water are both unlimited. Under the cloud everything is wet, warm and unfinished; when the cloud tears, the clear sky is the killer. Ships the biome (own worldgen placement worker, `RM_BiomeWorker_Contagion`, replacing the donor Alpha Biomes `BiomeWorker_OcularForest` — a donor type in `workerClass` is a hard dependency the RimMandrake tier may not assume), its full resident roster transplanted wholesale from the frozen campaign twin (11 `wildAnimals` rows, 10 `wildPlants` rows, Alpha Biomes/vanilla disease suite), and a Mod Settings screen with the standard worldgen-rarity master toggle (MOD_OPTIONS_RETROFIT_1 doctrine — default = shipped behavior, 0 = never generates).
`CONTAGION_GENOME_ORGAN_GROWING_1` (2026-09-26) added the mod's first real mechanic: a colonist can be operated on (`RM_ExtractGenomeSample`, a Medicine surgical bill) to draw a genome sample, then carry it to a live `AA_RedGoo` — the roster's own "the body" — and inject it (a right-click interaction, `RM_InjectGenomeSample`). The amoeba gestates for 4 in-game days (`RM_AmoebaGestation`), then dies producing 2-4 ordinary vanilla organs (kidney/liver/lung/heart) tagged with the source colonist's identity via a comp patched onto those four vanilla ThingDefs — the host is consumable, one batch per amoeba, per the owner's ruling. Gated by its own Mod Settings toggle, default on.
`CONTAGION_UNFINISHED_SPAWNER_1` (2026-09-26) added the mod's second mechanic: `AA_RedGoo` periodically buds a short-lived `RM_TheUnfinished` chimera nearby (`CompSpawnerUnfinished`, patched onto the donor the same way the genome comps above are). Each Unfinished rolls 1-3 random vanilla `Hediff_AddedPart` limbs from a small pool (claw/spike/fang/stump/vestigial wing/useless jaw — some armed, some not) onto random un-missing body parts, a rare (12%) "rolled a monster" combat buff, and a vanilla severity-per-day hediff randomised to kill it within a few in-game days. Death always dissolves the corpse to `Filth_Slime` via vanilla's own `DeathActionProperties_Vanish` — no corpse persists. Not part of the biome's ambient `wildAnimals` roster (it never breeds; it is budded), so ecosystem accounting is untouched. Gated by its own Mod Settings toggle, default on. Placeholder art only (a recolored vanilla Warg, this mod's own precedent) — `infrastructure/artpipe/done/` was checked first and holds no existing "Unfinished"/chimera art; bespoke art remains owed, queued separately.
`CONTAGION_MECHANICS_BUILD_1` Part 1 (2026-09-29): the Bloom and the Burn. The biome owns its sky — `RM_ContagionBloom` (red fog, rain, thunder, ranged accuracy x0.4) is the standing weather; the Burn (`RM_ContagionBurn`) is never rolled by vanilla weather but scheduled by `RM_MapComponent_ContagionSky` only on a biome carrying `RM_ContagionSkyExtension`, a few days apart. Shortly before each tear the gawpsacks stop and settle as one (the tell). During a Burn the fog lifts, UV-shy natives burn and dive for roof, canopy or water, the armored ones hunt, and anyone else in the open takes `RM_BurnDose`. Mod Settings: on/off, tells on/off, frequency, damage.
Two Helix devices (Parts 3/4, trade/quest items — not constructible): the `RM_Sunbeam` UV projector (weak, scarring burns on people; a Mod Settings multiplier, default 6x, against Contagion natives) and the `RM_CloudRepulsor` (plus the gravship-substructure `RM_CloudRepulsorShip`): powered and warmed up, it forces the Burn on a Contagion map and holds the sky clear of rain and fog anywhere else, drawing a violet beam while live.
The Coalescence (Part 2, `RM_Coalescence`): after a long Bloom the Contagion can gather into one stationary giant organism that pulls in and absorbs the Unfinished, grows through three staged forms, and emits manhunter Unfinished. Any Burn — natural or Repulsor-forced — collapses it into slime and genome samples. Mod Settings toggle, default on.
Zero Star Wars content lives in this biome's roster at all — the twin's own `wildAnimals` carries no `RSW_`/`SW_`/`mlie.*` row, so no Utinni patch is needed for fauna (unlike most sibling RM_ biome mods, there is no `WildAnimals_Contagion.xml`).
⚠️ One row is neither ours-standalone nor Star Wars: `RUT_Sytheclaw`, a RimMandrake-tier creature the frozen campaign shares inline across three biomes (Pyrelands, Greentide, here) whose ThingDef/PawnKindDef still live in the RimUtinni tier (`RUT_PyrelandsPortedFauna.xml`). Wiring it inline here would be a live cross-tier dependency (a franchise-free def needing a campaign-tier def to resolve), so it ships `MayRequire="mandrake.rut.patches"` — same caution `WildAnimals_Greentide.xml` already records for this same creature. It is one of 52 species `BIOME_SPECIFIC_FAUNA_LAW_1` lists as multi-homed and unadjudicated; multi-home evictions are stopped by owner ruling, so it is not moved or renamed here.
✅ CORRECTED 2026-09-29 (CONTAGION_FINAL_BAN_SWEEP_1): the paragraph this replaces described the pre-port donor roster (ten `wildPlants` rows on `sarg.alphaanimals`/`sarg.alphabiomes` gates) — stale since `CONTAGION_RULED_CONTENT_1` Wave A and `CONTAGION_FLORA_PORT_1` replaced the whole roster. Current state: `wildAnimals` (21 rows) and `wildPlants` (13 rows) are entirely `RM_`-owned with one exception, `RM_RustPuff` (`MayRequire="mandrake.rm.therot"`, a real cross-mod dependency on The Rot's kit — RustPuff itself lives in `mandrake.rm.therot`, not here). Terrain/ texture fields still carry no `MayRequire` (inherited unguarded from the frozen campaign twin, pre-existing gap, not introduced by this build).
NOT in this mod: the Ashfall Research Base and every other campaign plot hook (`OCULAR_OVERDRIVE_SITE_1`); F5, "the Contagion die-off ring," which is a mechanic of the neighboring Forge biome despite the name and already ships in `RimMandrake.EnvironmentalHazards` — its defs stay in RimUtinni pending `THEFORGE_RM_MOD_BUILD_1`, not this build.
Live proof (step 5, a scratch-world quicktest with all five expansions) is Desktop-only and OWED — see the item's own verify record.
